title: festuca ovina var. heteropachys
intro: Festuca ovina var. heteropachys, commonly known as Sheep's Fescue, is a type of grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of Sheep's Fescue include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential in wound healing and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of Sheep's Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
